definition_zh: 便利设施；舒适宜人的环境；愉快；（amenities）礼节
definition_en: a desirable or useful feature of a place; pleasantness; courtesies of social life
core_image: 酒店大堂那张舒服的沙发和免费的咖啡角：让日子过得舒服的小东西
scene: 新建的公寓楼下有健身房、花园和全天便利店。The building offers every modern amenity a resident could want.
sceneCN: 这里的 amenity 是「便利设施」（第 1 个义项：提高生活舒适度的设施）；句意是这栋楼提供住户想要的各种现代化便利设施。

derivatives.zh: 复数形式，常指成套的便利设施或社交礼节
同源近族词（词源关系存疑），义为「顺从的；乐于配合的」，注意区分

senses.title: A useful or pleasant feature of a place
senses.titleCN: 便利设施：让生活舒适方便的配置
senses.definition: a feature of a building or place that makes life there easier or more pleasant
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物或场所中使生活更方便舒适的配置
senses.example: The apartment complex includes a pool and other amenities.
senses.exampleCN: 这个公寓小区配有游泳池等便利设施。
senses.why: From the idea of pleasantness, real estate narrowed the word to the things that supply it.
senses.whyCN: 从「宜人」这个抽象概念出发，房地产行业把这个词具体化为提供舒适感的各种设施。

senses.title: The pleasant quality of a place or climate
senses.titleCN: 宜人：环境或气候的舒适特质
senses.definition: the pleasantness or attractiveness of surroundings or weather
senses.definitionCN: 环境或天气的舒适宜人之处
senses.example: Visitors praise the amenity of the coastal climate.
senses.exampleCN: 游客称赞沿海气候的宜人。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the quality itself before any object supplying it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：先有「宜人」这种性质，才有提供这种性质的物件。

senses.title: Pleasant social relations
senses.titleCN: 社交融洽：人际间的和乐
senses.definition: the pleasant quality of social interaction among people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间交往的和乐融洽
senses.example: Office amenity improved once the managers stopped shouting.
senses.exampleCN: 经理们不再吼叫后，办公室气氛融洽多了。
senses.why: Pleasantness of place extends naturally to pleasantness among the people in it.
senses.whyCN: 场所的宜人很自然地延伸为场所中人与人相处的宜人。

senses.title: Courtesies and polite conventions
senses.titleCN: 社交礼节：复数形式的客套规范
senses.definition: in the plural, the polite conventions observed in social or diplomatic life
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式，指社交或外交场合遵循的客套礼节
senses.example: Despite the dispute, the two delegations observed the amenities.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有分歧，两个代表团仍遵守外交礼节。
senses.why: Politeness is pleasantness maintained between strangers, so the word covers its rituals.
senses.whyCN: 礼貌就是陌生人之间维持的「宜人」，于是礼节也被这个词覆盖。

senses.title: Small complimentary items of comfort
senses.titleCN: 免费小用品：酒店洗漱包等
senses.definition: small complimentary items provided for comfort, such as toiletries in hotels
senses.definitionCN: 为舒适而提供的免费小物件，如酒店洗漱用品
senses.example: The room came with towels and complimentary amenities.
senses.exampleCN: 房间配有毛巾和免费洗漱用品。
senses.why: The hospitality industry shrank the broad sense to the tangible giveaways guests take home.
senses.whyCN: 酒店业把宽泛的「设施」义缩小到客人能带走的实物赠品上。

senses.title: Legal comfort interests in land
senses.titleCN: 法律上的环境舒适利益
senses.definition: in property law, the non-material benefits of land such as views or quiet
senses.definitionCN: 财产法中土地的非实体利益，如景观、安静
senses.example: The court weighed the loss of amenity caused by the new highway.
senses.exampleCN: 法院权衡了新高速公路造成的环境舒适损失。
senses.why: Law needs a word for comfort that has no price tag but has value.
senses.whyCN: 法律需要一个词指称那些没有标价却有价值的舒适利益。

intro.en: Amenity comes through Old French from Latin comitas-related roots of pleasantness; its link to amare, to love, is generally assumed.
intro.cn: amenity 经古法语来自拉丁语表示「宜人」的词，一般认为与表示「爱」的 amare 词根相关（关系存疑）。

items.en: amaenitas, pleasantness or charm, generally connected with amoenus, pleasing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amaenitas「宜人、魅力」，一般与 amoenus「令人愉悦的」相关。

items.en: amoenus may derive from amare, to love, though some scholars prefer an older Mediterranean word.
items.cn: amoenus 可能源自 amare「爱」，也有学者认为来自更古老的地中海语词（存疑）。

items.en: amenite, pleasantness, borrowed from Latin learned vocabulary.
items.cn: 古法语 amenite「宜人」，借自拉丁书面语。

items.en: English amenity first meant pleasantness of place or manner.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语 amenity 首先表示地点或举止的宜人。

items.en: The plural amenities widened to social courtesies, then to convenient facilities.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪复数 amenities 先扩为社交礼节，再转为便利设施。

items.en: Now the standard word for comfort features in real estate, hotels, and urban planning.
items.cn: 如今是房地产、酒店与城市规划中表示舒适设施的标准用词。

note.en: Separate amenity from its look-alike amenable and from rival words for comfort and convenience.
note.cn: 把 amenity 与形近词 amenable 区分开，也要与表示舒适便利的近义词区分。

entries.definition: willing to cooperate; a different root despite the shared opening letters.
entries.definitionCN: 顺从配合的；与 amenity 开头拼写相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: friendly in manner; from Latin amare, to love.
entries.definitionCN: 和蔼可亲的；源自拉丁语 amare「爱」。

entries.definition: rhyming abstract noun of -ity; dignity is worth, amenity is comfort.
entries.definitionCN: 同韵 -ity 抽象名词：dignity 是尊严，amenity 是舒适。

entries.definition: a space or equipment serving a function; more functional, less cozy.
entries.definitionCN: 设施、场所；偏功能性，少了「舒适」意味。

entries.definition: ease of use or access; stresses saving effort.
entries.definitionCN: 便利；强调省时省力。

entries.definition: physical ease and wellbeing; broader than a single feature.
entries.definitionCN: 舒适；泛指身心安适，范围比单一设施更宽。

normalIntro.en: Tie amenity to the pleasant little extras that make life easy.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amenity 和那些让生活舒服的小配置绑在一起记。

normal.en: amoenus (pleasing) + -ity (noun suffix): the state of being pleasing.
normal.cn: amoenus（令人愉悦的）+ -ity（名词后缀）：愉悦的属性。

normal.en: Plural rule: amenities almost always appear in real-estate ads.
normal.cn: 复数规律：amenities 几乎总出现在房产广告里。

normal.en: Same -ity family: dignity, facility, amenity — abstract qualities.
normal.cn: 同类 -ity 词：dignity（尊严）、facility（设施）、amenity（舒适）。

normal.en: observe the amenities = mind your social manners.
normal.cn: observe the amenities 即「讲社交礼节」。

normal.en: Hotel corridor memory: free shampoo, pool, gym — all amenities.
normal.cn: 酒店走廊记忆法：免费洗发水、泳池、健身房——全是 amenities。

abstract.en: Picture a lobby with a fireplace; the warmth you feel is the amenity.
abstract.cn: 想象带壁炉的大堂，你感到的那份暖意就是 amenity。

abstract.en: Amenity starts like 'a moment of ease' — a little break life hands you.
abstract.cn: amenity 开头读着像「a moment of ease」——生活送你的一小段安逸。

abstract.en: Think of a picnic table under shade trees: comfort built into a place.
abstract.cn: 想象树荫下的野餐桌——被「种」进场所里的舒适。

examples.en: The hotel lists its amenities on the booking page.
examples.cn: 酒店在预订页面列出各项设施。

examples.en: Lack of basic amenities made the village hard to live in.
examples.cn: 缺乏基本生活设施让这个村子难以居住。

examples.en: Both sides observed the amenities before the tough negotiation began.
examples.cn: 艰难谈判开始前，双方都讲究礼节寒暄了一番。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿妹捏提」——阿妹一进酒店就捏着托盘提来一堆免费小用品，全是便利设施。

root: 一般认为源自拉丁语 amaenitas（宜人），与 amoenus（令人愉悦的）相关，更早可能出自 amare（爱），但 amoenus 的更深层来源存在学术争议，宜存疑处理。

sensesIntro.en: Amenity runs from the abstract pleasantness of a climate down to hotel shampoo bottles and up to legal comfort interests.
sensesIntro.cn: amenity 上可指气候环境的宜人，下可指酒店免费用品，还进入法律指土地的舒适利益。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: comfort quietly built into a place
core.cn: 核心意象：悄悄安放在场所里的舒适

branches.en: Tangible comfort features and giveaway items
branches.cn: 实体设施与免费舒适小物

branches.en: The pleasantness of climate and landscape
branches.cn: 气候与风景的宜人

branches.en: Harmony among people sharing a place
branches.cn: 同处一地的人际融洽

branches.en: The polite rituals that keep interaction pleasant
branches.cn: 维持交往愉悦的礼节

branches.en: Comfort recognized as valuable by law
branches.cn: 被法律承认有价值的舒适利益

intro.en: Amenity is a Latin abstract noun ending in -ity, naming the quality of being pleasing.
intro.cn: amenity 是以 -ity 结尾的拉丁式抽象名词，表示「令人愉悦」这一性质。

latinIntro.en: The -itas family of Latin supplies English with hundreds of -ity nouns.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 -itas 词族为英语提供了数百个 -ity 名词。

items.example: the sports facility opened in May
she faced the loss with dignity

items.meaning: mild weather; adjectival parallel of the amenity sense
items.meaningCN: 宜人的气候；与 amenity 第 2 义平行
items.example: they moved south for the amiable climate
items.exampleCN: 他们为宜人气候搬去了南方
当地人的好客令游客难忘

items.example: the story lost plausibility under questioning
items.exampleCN: 这个故事在盘问下显得不可信了

definition_zh: 和蔼可亲的；友善的；亲切温和的
definition_en: friendly, good-natured, and pleasant to be around
core_image: 见面先笑的老人：语气软、眉头松，让人想靠近
scene: 小区门口的保安每天清晨都笑着跟住户打招呼。Our doorman greeted everyone with an amiable smile every morning.
sceneCN: 这里的 amiable 是「和蔼可亲的」（第 1 个义项：性情友善令人愉快）；句意是我们的门卫每天早上都带着和蔼的微笑问候大家。

derivatives.zh: 形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「和蔼地；亲切地」
形容词加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「和蔼；亲切」
同根形容词，义为「友好的；（关系）和睦的」，多形容双方关系而非性格

senses.title: Friendly and pleasant in character
senses.titleCN: 和蔼可亲的：性格友善讨人喜欢
senses.definition: having a disposition that is friendly and easy to like
senses.definitionCN: 性情友善、让人容易产生好感的
senses.example: An amiable guide made the long tour enjoyable.
senses.exampleCN: 和蔼的导游让漫长的参观变得愉快。
senses.why: The Latin root amare means to love; a lovable person is one others naturally warm to.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 amare 意为「爱」，可爱的人自然让他人愿意亲近。

senses.title: Good-natured and unarguing in mood
senses.titleCN: 温和好脾气的：不易动怒
senses.definition: showing a mild temper that avoids conflict or harshness
senses.definitionCN: 脾气温和、避免冲突与苛刻的
senses.example: He stayed amiable even when the flight was delayed twice.
senses.exampleCN: 即使航班两度延误，他依然保持好脾气。
senses.why: Loving forbids hating, so the amiable person lets irritations pass.
senses.whyCN: 既然根义是「爱」，就容不得恼恨，和蔼的人于是不与人计较。

senses.title: Warm and relaxed in social atmosphere
senses.titleCN: 气氛融洽的：社交场合轻松友好
senses.definition: describing an atmosphere or occasion marked by friendliness
senses.definitionCN: 形容气氛或场合充满友好气息
senses.example: The interview ended in an amiable chat about travel.
senses.exampleCN: 面试最后变成一段关于旅行的轻松闲聊。
senses.why: Personal warmth spills over to color the whole setting.
senses.whyCN: 个人的温和会晕染开，给整个场合上色。

senses.title: Good-naturedly competitive
senses.titleCN: 善意的：用于不伤和气的竞争
senses.definition: friendly in tone even within rivalry or disagreement
senses.definitionCN: 即便在竞争分歧中也保持友好基调
senses.example: The two firms kept up an amiable rivalry for decades.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司维持了几十年善意的竞争。
senses.why: Love can coexist with contest; the word marks rivalry without hostility.
senses.whyCN: 「爱」可以与竞争共存，这个词标记的就是不带敌意的较量。

senses.title: Agreeable in appearance or style
senses.titleCN: 悦目讨喜的：外观风格令人愉快
senses.definition: pleasant in look, manner, or style rather than deep character
senses.definitionCN: 外表、举止或风格令人愉快，未必涉及深层品格
senses.example: The novel is amiable but not profound.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说讨喜但不够深刻。
senses.why: The surface charm of lovable things can be praised even where depth is missing.
senses.whyCN: 可爱事物的表层魅力可以被单独称赞，即便缺乏深度。

intro.en: Amiable descends from Latin amare, to love, through the Late Latin amicabilis and Old French amiable.
intro.cn: amiable 源自拉丁语 amare「爱」，经晚期拉丁语 amicabilis 和古法语 amiable 进入英语。

items.en: Root *am-, to love, also seen in amateur.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *am-「爱」，也见于 amateur（爱好者）。

items.en: amare, to love; amicus, friend; amicabilis, friendly.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amare「爱」；amicus「朋友」；amicabilis「友好的」。

items.en: amicabilis and its variant form amiable began to overlap in sense with lovely.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语中 amicabilis 及其变体开始与「可爱」之义重叠。

items.en: amiable meant lovable or worthy of love.
items.cn: 古法语 amiable 意为「可爱的、值得爱的」。

items.en: English amiable first meant lovable, then settled into friendly and pleasant.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语 amiable 先指「可爱」，后固定为「友善和蔼」。

items.en: Now describes a good-natured person or friendly atmosphere.
items.cn: 如今形容好脾气的人或友好的氛围。

note.en: Distinguish amiable from its sibling amicable, from the unloving amenable, and from near-synonyms of friendliness.
note.cn: 区分 amiable 与孪生词 amicable、词形相近的 amenable，以及表示友善的近义词。

entries.definition: peaceable between parties, describing relations not personality.
entries.definitionCN: 和睦友好的，形容双方关系而非个人性格，与 amiable 同根易混。

entries.definition: willing to obey or cooperate; from a driving root, not the love root.
entries.definitionCN: 顺从配合的；源自「驱赶」词根而非「爱」词根，仅形近。

entries.definition: one who does something for love, not pay; shares the amare root.
entries.definitionCN: 业余爱好者；因「热爱」而非报酬行事，同属 amare 词根。

entries.definition: easy to talk to; stresses approachability in conversation.
entries.definitionCN: 和蔼健谈的；强调易于交谈。

entries.definition: warmly heartfelt; stronger emotional warmth than amiable.
entries.definitionCN: 热情诚恳的；情感温度比 amiable 更高。

entries.definition: cheerfully warm and sociable.
entries.definitionCN: 亲切欢快的；多带明朗愉快色彩。

normalIntro.en: Remember amiable through its loving root.
normalIntro.cn: 从「爱」的词根入手记住 amiable。

normal.en: am- (love) + -able (worthy of): worthy of being loved.
normal.cn: am-（爱）+ -able（值得的）：值得被爱的。

normal.en: Family: amiable, amicable, amateur, amour — all from amare.
normal.cn: 词族：amiable、amicable、amateur、amour——全部来自 amare。

normal.en: Split: amiable = friendly person; amicable = friendly settlement.
normal.cn: 分工：amiable 形容人友善；amicable 形容关系和解。

normal.en: amiability is the noun; amiably is the adverb.
normal.cn: 名词是 amiability（和蔼），副词是 amiably（和蔼地）。

normal.en: Sound cue: amiable begins like 'aim to be lovable'.
normal.cn: 读音提示：amiable 开头像「aim to be lovable」（立志可爱）。

abstract.en: Picture a golden retriever greeting every guest — amiable in fur form.
abstract.cn: 想象金毛犬迎接每位客人——毛茸茸版的「和蔼可亲」。

abstract.en: Hear a neighbor's easy laugh over the fence; that laugh is amiable.
abstract.cn: 听见篱笆那边邻居随和的笑声——那就是 amiable。

abstract.en: Amiable people leave you feeling loved, because their root is love.
abstract.cn: 和蔼的人让你感到被喜爱，因为他们的词根就是「爱」。

examples.en: Her amiable manner put the nervous candidate at ease.
examples.cn: 她亲切的态度让紧张的候选人放松下来。

examples.en: They parted on amiable terms after years as partners.
examples.cn: 合作多年后，他们友好地散了伙。

examples.en: An amiable old man feeds the pigeons in the square daily.
examples.cn: 一位和蔼的老人每天在广场喂鸽子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱蜜宝」——像疼爱蜜糖宝贝一样待人，语气甜、脾气软，谁见了都喜欢。

root: 拉丁语 amare（爱）→ 晚期拉丁语 amicabilis（友好的）→ 古法语 amiable（可爱的）→ 英语 amiable（和蔼可亲的）。同根词：amicable（和睦的）、amateur（爱好者）、amour（恋情）、enamor（使迷恋）。

sensesIntro.en: From being worthy of love, amiable spreads to mild tempers, warm atmospheres, gentle rivalry, and pleasing style.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「值得爱」出发，amiable 延伸到温和脾气、友好气氛、善意竞争与讨喜风格。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person easy to love
core.cn: 核心意象：让人一眼就想亲近的人

branches.en: Lovable character and even temper
branches.cn: 讨人喜欢的性格与好脾气

branches.en: Atmospheres colored by friendliness
branches.cn: 被友好染色的氛围

branches.en: Contest kept free of hostility
branches.cn: 不带敌意的竞争

branches.en: Surface charm without depth claims
branches.cn: 不涉及深度的表层魅力

branches.en: Even temper that lets irritations pass
branches.cn: 让不快轻易过去的好脾气

intro.en: Amiable joins the love root am- with the adjective suffix -able, the pattern of worthiness.
intro.cn: amiable 由「爱」词根 am- 加形容词后缀 -able 组成，表示「值得……的」。

latinIntro.en: Latin amare seeded a large family of English words about love and friendship.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 amare 播下了英语中一大批关于爱与友谊的词。

items.meaning: one who does it for love

items.example: amicus brief filed by a friend of the court

items.meaning: a woman someone is in love with

definition_zh: 和睦；友好关系；亲善
definition_en: a friendly, peaceful relationship between people, groups, or nations
core_image: 握手后的和平：曾经的对手坐上了同一张桌子
scene: 停战协议签订后，两国边境市场重新热闹起来。The treaty restored amity between the two bordering nations.
sceneCN: 这里的 amity 是「和睦、友好关系」（第 1 个义项：国家或群体间的和平友好）；句意是条约恢复了两个邻国之间的和睦关系。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「友好的；心平气和的」，形容关系与解决方式
同根形容词，义为「和蔼可亲的」，形容个人性情
amicable 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「友好地；心平气和地」

senses.title: Peaceful relations between groups or nations
senses.titleCN: 国家群体间的和睦友好
senses.definition: a state of friendship and peace between countries, organizations, or communities
senses.definitionCN: 国家、组织或社区之间的友好和平状态
senses.example: Centuries of amity followed the marriage alliance.
senses.exampleCN: 联姻结盟之后是几个世纪的睦邻友好。
senses.why: From Latin amicus, friend: nations that treat each other as friends live without war.
senses.whyCN: 源自拉丁语 amicus「朋友」：把彼此当朋友的国家便无战事。

senses.title: Harmony among individuals
senses.titleCN: 个人间的融洽和睦
senses.definition: friendly accord between individual persons, especially former opponents
senses.definitionCN: 个人之间的友好一致，尤其指昔日的对手之间
senses.example: The old rivals retired to the bar in complete amity.
senses.exampleCN: 这对老对手赛后一起去酒吧，相处融洽。
senses.why: The friend-image scales down from nations to any pair of people.
senses.whyCN: 「朋友」意象可以从国家缩小到任意两个人之间。

senses.title: Formal friendship sealed by agreement
senses.titleCN: 条约中的正式友好
senses.definition: friendship declared or guaranteed in a formal document, as in treaties of amity
senses.definitionCN: 见于正式文件、被宣告或保障的友好，如友好条约
senses.example: The two republics signed a treaty of amity and commerce.
senses.exampleCN: 两个共和国签署了友好通商条约。
senses.why: Diplomacy needed a dignified noun for friendship, and amity supplied it.
senses.whyCN: 外交需要一个庄重的名词来表示「友谊」，amity 正好承担此职。

senses.title: Goodwill and cooperation without hostility
senses.titleCN: 无敌意的善意合作
senses.definition: an attitude of goodwill that keeps cooperation free of antagonism
senses.definitionCN: 使合作免于敌对的善意态度
senses.example: The merger talks proceeded in an atmosphere of amity.
senses.exampleCN: 并购谈判在友好的气氛中进行。
senses.why: Friendship is not only a status but a spirit that shapes how business is done.
senses.whyCN: 友谊不仅是状态，更是一种塑造做事方式的精神。

senses.title: Concord within a community or family
senses.titleCN: 社区家庭内部的和睦
senses.definition: peace and accord within a household, sect, or small community
senses.definitionCN: 家庭、教派或小团体内部的和平一致
senses.example: Family amity survived even the quarrel over the will.
senses.exampleCN: 即使为遗嘱争吵，家人依旧和睦。
senses.why: The smallest 'nation' is the family, and friendship scales all the way down.
senses.whyCN: 最小的「国」是家，「朋友」意象可以一路缩到家门之内。

intro.en: Amity comes from Latin amicus, friend, through Old French amitie, meaning friendship.
intro.cn: amity 源自拉丁语 amicus「朋友」，经古法语 amitie（友谊）进入英语。

items.en: Root *am-, to love or be attached.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *am-「爱、依恋」。

items.en: amicus, friend; amicitia, friendship.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amicus「朋友」；amicitia「友谊」。

items.en: amitie, friendship, borrowed from Latin amicitia.
items.cn: 古法语 amitie「友谊」，借自拉丁语 amicitia。

items.en: English amity appears in diplomatic and moral writing for peaceful accord.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语 amity 出现于外交与道德文字，指和平和睦。

items.en: Treaties of amity became a fixed formula in European statecraft.
items.cn: 「友好条约」成为欧洲国家交往的固定用语。

items.en: Now a formal or literary word for harmony between peoples or persons.
items.cn: 如今是表示民族或人际和谐的书卷用语。

note.en: Keep amity apart from its sibling amiable and from near rivals for peace and friendship.
note.cn: 把 amity 与同根词 amiable 区分开，并与其他表示和平友谊的近义词对比。

entries.definition: adjective for a lovable person; amity is the noun for the resulting harmony.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容人可爱和蔼；amity 是由此产生的和睦关系名词。

entries.definition: adjective for relations settled without conflict, as an amicable divorce.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容关系无冲突地解决，如友好离婚。

entries.definition: active hostility; from Latin inimicus, not-a-friend — the mirror opposite of amity.
entries.definitionCN: 敌意；源自 inimicus「非朋友」，恰为 amity 的反面，注意拼写仅差两个字母。

entries.definition: agreement and harmony, often within a group.
entries.definitionCN: 和谐一致，多指群体内部。

entries.definition: pleasing agreement in general, musical or social.
entries.definitionCN: 和谐；泛指协调一致，可用于音乐或人际关系。

entries.definition: benevolent attitude; the inner disposition behind amity.
entries.definitionCN: 善意；amity 背后的内心态度。

normalIntro.en: Hold on to the friend-root to keep amity in place.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住「朋友」词根，amity 就跑不掉。

normal.en: amicus (friend) + -ity: the state of being friends.
normal.cn: amicus（朋友）+ -ity（名词后缀）：成为朋友的状态。

normal.en: Treaty of Amity and Commerce is a real treaty formula — memorize the phrase.
normal.cn: 「友好通商条约」是真实条约用语——把这个短语背下来。

normal.en: Contrast pair: amity vs enmity (friend vs not-friend).
normal.cn: 对比组：amity（和睦）对 enmity（敌意），朋友对非朋友。

normal.en: Family chain: amare → amicus → amity, amiable, amicable.
normal.cn: 词族链：amare（爱）→ amicus（朋友）→ amity、amiable、amicable。

normal.en: a-MITY rhymes with community — communities need amity.
normal.cn: a-MITY 与 community 押韵——社区需要和睦。

abstract.en: See two flags hung side by side after a treaty signing.
abstract.cn: 想象条约签署后并排悬挂的两面国旗。

abstract.en: Picture former rivals sharing one umbrella in the rain.
abstract.cn: 想象昔日的对手在雨里共撑一把伞。

abstract.en: Amity sounds like 'amity and light' — picture a border village lit in peace.
abstract.cn: amity 读来像「安宁与光」——想象和平灯火下的边境村庄。

examples.en: The festival was founded to promote amity among the immigrant communities.
examples.cn: 创办这个节日是为了促进移民社区之间的和睦。

examples.en: After decades of hostility, the neighbors finally lived in amity.
examples.cn: 敌对数十年后，两国邻居终于和睦相处。

examples.en: The summit closed with a declaration of amity and cooperation.
examples.cn: 峰会以一项睦邻合作宣言闭幕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱么提」——「爱」么？提着礼物走亲戚，国与国、家与家互相提携，就是和睦亲善。

root: 拉丁语 amicus（朋友）→ 拉丁语 amicitia（友谊）→ 古法语 amitie → 英语 amity（和睦）。更早源自印欧词根 *am-（爱），与 amare（爱）同族；同根词有 amiable、amicable、amicus brief（法院之友意见书）。

sensesIntro.en: From being friends, amity grows into national peace, personal accord, treaty language, and family concord.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「做朋友」出发，amity 扩展为国家和平、个人融洽、条约用语与家庭和睦。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: former enemies becoming friends at one table
core.cn: 核心意象：昔日的对手同桌成为朋友

branches.en: Peace between nations and organizations
branches.cn: 国家与组织之间的和平

branches.en: Concord among individuals, families, and communities
branches.cn: 个人、家庭与社区间的融洽

branches.en: Friendship written into formal treaties
branches.cn: 写进正式条约的友谊

branches.en: The goodwill spirit inside cooperation
branches.cn: 合作中的善意精神

branches.en: Former rivals reconciled as friends
branches.cn: 昔日对手言归于好

intro.en: Amity is the -ity noun of friendship, sister to amiable and amicable.
intro.cn: amity 是「友谊」的 -ity 名词，与 amiable、amicable 是姊妹词。

latinIntro.en: The amicus family marks every English word built on friend.
latinIntro.cn: amicus 词族标记了英语中一切由「朋友」构成的词。

items.example: amicus curiae, a friend of the court

items.exampleCN: inimical 政策即对你不利的政策

items.meaning: old treaty line dividing zones of war and peace
items.meaningCN: 历史术语：划分战区和和平区的「和平线」

definition_zh: 遗忘症；失忆；记忆缺失
definition_en: partial or total loss of memory, especially from illness, injury, or shock
core_image: 被橡皮擦擦掉的记事本：过去的页面突然一片空白
scene: 车祸醒来后，他连自己的名字都说不出来。The accident left him with temporary amnesia.
sceneCN: 这里的 amnesia 是「失忆症」（第 1 个义项：因伤病导致的记忆丧失）；句意是这场事故让他患上了暂时性失忆。

derivatives.zh: 加名词后缀 -ac 构成，义为「失忆症患者」；亦可作形容词「失忆的」
加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「失忆的；引起失忆的」

senses.title: Loss of memory caused by injury or illness
senses.titleCN: 病理性失忆：伤病造成的记忆丧失
senses.definition: the medical condition of losing memories, wholly or partly, because of brain injury or disease
senses.definitionCN: 因脑损伤或疾病而全部或部分丧失记忆的病症
senses.example: The boxer's amnesia erased the night of the fight.
senses.exampleCN: 这位拳手的失忆抹去了比赛当晚的记忆。
senses.why: The Greek root mnasthai means to remember, and the prefix a- cancels it outright.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语词根 mnasthai 意为「记得」，否定前缀 a- 直接将其取消。

senses.title: Inability to form new memories
senses.titleCN: 顺行性失忆：无法形成新记忆
senses.definition: the condition of being unable to retain new information after an event
senses.definitionCN: 某事件之后无法留存新信息的状态
senses.example: After the surgery he developed anterograde amnesia.
senses.exampleCN: 手术后他患上了顺行性失忆。
senses.why: Medicine split the blank page in two: nothing before, or nothing after.
senses.whyCN: 医学把「空白页」一分为二：之前记不住，或之后存不进。

senses.title: Loss of memories from before an event
senses.titleCN: 逆行性失忆：忘记事发之前的往事
senses.definition: loss of memories acquired before the injury or onset of illness
senses.definitionCN: 丧失受伤或发病之前获得的记忆
senses.example: Retrograde amnesia took away her wedding day.
senses.exampleCN: 逆行性失忆带走了她婚礼那天的记忆。
senses.why: The erased page is behind the patient; the past is what vanishes.
senses.whyCN: 被擦掉的页码在患者身后——消失的是过去。

senses.title: Psychologically motivated forgetting
senses.titleCN: 心因性遗忘：因心理冲击而忘却
senses.definition: memory loss attributed to emotional trauma rather than physical damage
senses.definitionCN: 归因于情感创伤而非躯体损伤的记忆丧失
senses.example: His amnesia about the crash was the mind's shield.
senses.exampleCN: 他对车祸的失忆是心灵自我保护的盾牌。
senses.why: The mind can also reach for the eraser when remembering hurts too much.
senses.whyCN: 当回忆过于痛苦，心灵也会主动拿起橡皮擦。

senses.title: Figurative forgetting by a group or public
senses.titleCN: 集体失忆：群体对往事的遗忘
senses.definition: a society's or group's failure to remember its own past
senses.definitionCN: 社会或群体对自身历史的遗忘
senses.example: The town's collective amnesia hid the factory disaster from memory.
senses.exampleCN: 小镇的集体失忆让工厂事故从记忆中消失。
senses.why: What an individual brain does, a culture can do too, metaphorically.
senses.whyCN: 个体大脑会发生的事，文化在隐喻上同样会发生。

senses.title: Convenient forgetting of duty or facts
senses.titleCN: 选择性健忘：对义务事实的装忘
senses.definition: informal forgetfulness about obligations or inconvenient facts, as if deliberate
senses.definitionCN: 对义务或不便事实的健忘，仿佛有意为之
senses.example: The agency suffers amnesia every audit season.
senses.exampleCN: 每到审计季，这个机构就「失忆」。
senses.why: Speakers borrowed the medical term to accuse others of convenient forgetting.
senses.whyCN: 人们借医学术语来指责他人「 conveniently 忘记」该记得的事。

intro.en: Amnesia is a Greek coinage: the prefix a- (not) plus mnasthai (to remember), later applied to memory loss.
intro.cn: amnesia 是希腊语造词：前缀 a-（不）加 mnasthai（记得），后被用于指记忆丧失。

items.en: Root *men-, to think, also seen in mind and mental.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *men-「思考」，也见于 mind、mental。

items.en: mnasthai, to remember; related to mneme, memory, and Mnemosyne, the memory goddess.
items.cn: 希腊语 mnasthai「记得」，与 mneme（记忆）及记忆女神 Mnemosyne 同族。

items.en: amnesia formed with a- (not) for forgetfulness.
items.cn: 希腊语加否定前缀 a- 构成 amnesia「健忘」。

items.en: amnesia entered medical Latin as a term for loss of memory.
items.cn: amnesia 以「记忆丧失」之意进入新拉丁医学术语。

items.en: English amnesia appears in medical texts around 1700.
items.cn: 约 1700 年前后，英语 amnesia 见于医学文献。

items.en: Now covers clinical syndromes and figurative group or convenient forgetting.
items.cn: 如今既指临床综合征，也用于集体或选择性遗忘的比喻。

note.en: Set amnesia against its memory-root cousins and near words for forgetting.
note.cn: 把 amnesia 与同属「记忆」词根的词以及其他表示遗忘的词区分开。

entries.definition: an official pardon; literally not-remembering a crime — same root, different target.
entries.definitionCN: 大赦；字面即「不再记得罪行」，同根但对象不同，注意区分。

entries.definition: a memory aid; the opposite in meaning, sharing the mn- root.
entries.definitionCN: 记忆辅助物；意义与 amnesia 相反，同属 mn- 词根。

entries.definition: sleeplessness; built like amnesia with a negative prefix plus a Greek noun.
entries.definitionCN: 失眠；构词与 amnesia 平行：否定前缀加希腊名词。

entries.definition: everyday failing to remember, without medical implication.
entries.definitionCN: 日常健忘，不带病理含义。

entries.definition: a span of lost memory, often from alcohol or fainting.
entries.definitionCN: 记忆断片，常因醉酒或晕厥。

entries.definition: progressive cognitive decline of which memory loss is one part.
entries.definitionCN: 渐进性认知衰退，记忆丧失只是其一部分。

normalIntro.en: Use the mn- root family to fix amnesia in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 用 mn- 词根家族把 amnesia 钉在记忆里。

normal.en: a- (not) + mnesia (remember): not-remembering.
normal.cn: a-（不）+ mnesia（记得）：不记得。

normal.en: Same root trio: amnesia (loss), amnesty (pardon), mnemonic (aid).
normal.cn: 同根三兄弟：amnesia（失忆）、amnesty（赦免）、mnemonic（记忆术）。

normal.en: Parallel words: insomnia (not sleeping), anesthesia (not feeling).
normal.cn: 平行词：insomnia（不眠）、anesthesia（无感觉）。

normal.en: Retrograde = backwards before; anterograde = forwards after.
normal.cn: retrograde（逆行）忘的是从前；anterograde（顺行）存不进以后。

normal.en: amnesiac is the patient; amnesic is the adjective.
normal.cn: amnesiac 指患者；amnesic 是形容词。

abstract.en: Picture an eraser sweeping across a diary until the pages are blank.
abstract.cn: 想象橡皮擦扫过日记本，纸页一片空白。

abstract.en: Mnemosyne the memory goddess turns her back, and names vanish.
abstract.cn: 记忆女神 Mnemosyne 转过身去，名字随之消失。

abstract.en: A man holding a suitcase with no label: everything about himself erased.
abstract.cn: 一个拎着无标签行李箱的人：关于自己的一切都被抹去。

examples.en: The novel's hero wakes on a beach with total amnesia.
examples.cn: 小说主人公在海滩上醒来，完全失忆。

examples.en: Doctors tested his memory for signs of amnesia.
examples.cn: 医生检测他的记忆，寻找失忆的迹象。

examples.en: The nation must not fall into amnesia about its darkest chapter.
examples.cn: 这个民族绝不能对最黑暗的一章集体失忆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿姆你谢」——阿姆见到你却鞠躬说「您是哪位」？因为他失忆了，认不出人。

root: 希腊语 a-（不）+ mnasthai（记得，源自印欧词根 *men-「思考」）→ 新拉丁医学用语 amnesia → 英语 amnesia（失忆）。同根词：amnesty（大赦）、mnemonic（记忆术）、Mnemosyne（记忆女神）、mind、mental。

sensesIntro.en: From the clinical blank page, amnesia spreads to trauma-forgotten pasts, new-memory failures, and societies that forget on purpose.
sensesIntro.cn: 从临床的「空白页」出发，amnesia 扩展到创伤遗忘、新记忆障碍，以及群体的选择性遗忘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a diary page wiped blank
core.cn: 核心意象：被擦成空白的日记页

branches.en: Medical memory loss from damage or disease
branches.cn: 损伤疾病导致的病理性记忆丧失

branches.en: Directional syndromes: before or after the event
branches.cn: 方向性综合征：忘前或忘后

branches.en: The mind's protective forgetting
branches.cn: 心灵自我保护的遗忘

branches.en: Societies erasing their own record
branches.cn: 社会抹去自身记忆

branches.en: Individuals conveniently forgetting duties
branches.cn: 个人对义务的装忘

intro.en: Amnesia shows the Greek negative a- joined to a memory root, a pattern copied by many medical terms.
intro.cn: amnesia 体现希腊否定前缀 a- 加「记忆」词根的构词，许多医学术语都仿照这一模式。

latinIntro.en: The same mn- root and a- prefix travel together through Greek-derived vocabulary.
latinIntro.cn: 同样的 mn- 词根与 a- 前缀在希腊源词汇中结伴出现。

items.meaningCN: 大赦；对罪行的「不再记得」

items.meaning: goddess of memory, mother of the Muses
items.exampleCN: 记忆女神启发了古代诗人

definition_zh: 含情脉脉的；多情的；表示爱情的；好色的
definition_en: showing love or sexual desire, especially in looks or behavior
core_image: 眼波流转的目光：眼里藏不住爱意
scene: 烛光晚餐上，他望着爱人，眼里满是温柔笑意。He gave his wife an amorous glance across the candlelit table.
sceneCN: 这里的 amorous 是「含情脉脉的」（第 1 个义项：流露爱意的）；句意是他在烛光餐桌对面深情地望了妻子一眼。

derivatives.zh: 形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「含情地；多情地」
形容词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「多情；柔情」
加施动者后缀 -ist 构成，义为「写爱情主题的作家；多情的人」

senses.title: Showing love in looks or manner
senses.titleCN: 含情脉脉的：神情举止流露爱意
senses.definition: expressing romantic love through glances, gestures, or words
senses.definitionCN: 以眼神、举止或言语表达浪漫爱意
senses.example: The poet described lovers trading amorous glances.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人描写恋人之间交换含情的目光。
senses.why: From Latin amor, love: whatever love shows on the surface is amorous.
senses.whyCN: 源自拉丁语 amor「爱」：爱流露在表面的一切就是 amorous。

senses.title: Strongly inclined to romance or desire
senses.titleCN: 多情的：生性易动情
senses.definition: having or readily showing strong romantic or sexual desire
senses.definitionCN: 具有或易于表现出强烈的浪漫或情欲渴望
senses.example: Spring makes even the oldest tomcat amorous.
senses.exampleCN: 春天连最老的雄猫都动了春心。
senses.why: Love as a force inside a person, not just a gesture, becomes an inclination.
senses.whyCN: 爱不只是流露的姿态，更是体内的力量，于是词义变成一种「倾向」。

senses.title: Concerning sexual desire
senses.titleCN: 情欲的：偏重肉体的渴望
senses.definition: relating to sexual appetite rather than tender affection
senses.definitionCN: 偏指性欲而非温柔爱慕
senses.example: The novel censors blurred its amorous passages.
senses.exampleCN: 书刊审查模糊了小说中的情欲段落。
senses.why: Romance and appetite share the same root word, and usage can tilt to either.
senses.whyCN: 浪漫与欲望共用同一词根，用法的重心可以偏向任何一边。

senses.title: Of love as a literary subject
senses.titleCN: 爱情题材的：文学主题
senses.definition: pertaining to love as a theme in literature or art
senses.definitionCN: 关于文学艺术中爱情主题的
senses.example: The troubadours wrote amorous songs for the court.
senses.exampleCN: 游吟诗人为宫廷谱写爱情歌曲。
senses.why: Once love becomes material for art, the adjective labels the genre.
senses.whyCN: 当爱成为艺术素材，形容词便用来标记这一题材。

senses.title: Eagerly pursuing romance
senses.titleCN: 求爱的：主动追逐恋情
senses.definition: actively courting or pursuing someone romantically
senses.definitionCN: 主动向人示爱求爱
senses.example: An amorous suitor left flowers at her door daily.
senses.exampleCN: 一位痴情的追求者每天在她门口留下鲜花。
senses.why: Desire presses toward action; the word follows the motion of courtship.
senses.whyCN: 渴望会推动行动，这个词便追随求爱的动作。

intro.en: Amorous comes from Latin amor, love, through Old French amoreus, replacing an older native formation.
intro.cn: amorous 源自拉丁语 amor「爱」，经古法语 amoreus 进入英语，取代了较早的本族构词。

items.en: Root *am-, to love.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *am-「爱」。

items.en: amor, love; amare, to love; also Cupid's title Amor.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amor「爱」；amare「爱」；也是丘比特的别称 Amor。

items.en: amoreus, full of love.
items.cn: 古法语 amoreus「充满爱意的」。

items.en: amorous appears in courtly love poetry.
items.cn: 中世纪英语 amorous 出现在宫廷爱情诗中。

items.en: Chaucer and successors used it for both tender love and appetite.
items.cn: 乔叟及其后继者用它兼指温柔之爱与情欲。

items.en: Now covers romantic expression, desire, love themes, and courtship.
items.cn: 如今涵盖浪漫表达、情欲、爱情题材与求爱。

note.en: Distinguish amorous from amiable and amicable, and from near words of desire and romance.
note.cn: 区分 amorous 与 amiable、amicable，以及表示欲望与浪漫的近义词。

entries.definition: friendly in character; amiable people are pleasant, amorous ones are in love.
entries.definitionCN: 和蔼可亲的；amiable 说性格，amorous 说爱意，同根易混。

entries.definition: without moral sense; from a- plus moral, not from amor.
entries.definitionCN: 非道德的；由 a- 加 moral 构成，与「爱」无关，仅形近。

entries.definition: of love, especially in literature; the bookish twin of amorous.
entries.definitionCN: 爱情的；多指文学语境，是 amorous 的书卷孪生词。

entries.definition: marked by idealized love; softer and more idealistic than amorous.
entries.definitionCN: 浪漫的；比 amorous 更理想化、更含蓄。

entries.definition: filled with intense emotion, of any kind.
entries.definitionCN: 热烈的；泛指强烈情感，不限于爱情。

entries.definition: driven by sexual appetite, without affection.
entries.definitionCN: 好色的；只有欲望而无爱意，贬义更重。

normalIntro.en: Keep amorous attached to amor, love itself.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amorous 与 amor「爱」本身拴在一起。

normal.en: amor + -ous: full of love.
normal.cn: amor（爱）+ -ous（充满……的）：满是爱意。

normal.en: Family: amorous, amatory, amour, amateur — all love-rooted.
normal.cn: 词族：amorous、amatory、amour、amateur——全部源于「爱」。

normal.en: Tilt of meaning: romance up front, appetite behind.
normal.cn: 词义倾斜：前面是浪漫，背后是欲望。

normal.en: Cupid's Latin name is Amor — picture his arrow for amorous.
normal.cn: 丘比特的拉丁名就是 Amor——想到他之箭就想到 amorous。

normal.en: Phrase set: amorous glance, amorous advances, amorous poetry.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：amorous glance（含情目光）、amorous advances（示爱）、amorous poetry（爱情诗）。

abstract.en: Two people under one umbrella, eyes only for each other.
abstract.cn: 一把伞下的两个人，眼中只有彼此。

abstract.en: Hear 'a-mour-ous' inside it: amour, a love affair, hiding in plain sight.
abstract.cn: 词中藏着 amour（恋情）：读出来就听见了「爱」。

abstract.en: A cat rubbing against your leg in spring — amorous in fur form.
abstract.cn: 春天的猫蹭你的腿——毛茸茸版的「多情」。

examples.en: He wrote her amorous letters throughout the war.
examples.cn: 战争期间他不停地给她写情书。

examples.en: She laughed off his amorous advances at the party.
examples.cn: 派对上她笑着回绝了他的示爱。

examples.en: The film's amorous subplot charmed the audience.
examples.cn: 影片的爱情支线情节迷住了观众。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱摸若死」——热恋的人总想「爱摸」对方的手，摸不到就「若死」般难受，多情至极。

root: 拉丁语 amare（爱）→ amor（爱情）→ 古法语 amoreus（充满爱意的）→ 中世纪英语 amorous。同根词：amatory（爱情的）、amour（恋情）、amateur（爱好者）、enamor（使迷恋）。

sensesIntro.en: From love shown in glances, amorous runs to desire, love as a literary theme, and eager courtship.
sensesIntro.cn: 从目光中流露的爱意出发，amorous 延伸到情欲、爱情文学主题与主动求爱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: love that shows in the eyes
core.cn: 核心意象：藏不住的、从眼中溢出的爱

branches.en: Love visible in glances and gestures
branches.cn: 眼神举止中的爱意

branches.en: The inner inclination toward romance
branches.cn: 内心易动情的倾向

branches.en: Desire without tenderness
branches.cn: 偏重情欲的一面

branches.en: Love as material for songs and books
branches.cn: 作为创作题材的爱情

branches.en: Active pursuit of a beloved
branches.cn: 主动热烈的追求

intro.en: Amorous is amor plus the adjective suffix -ous, meaning full of love.
intro.cn: amorous 由 amor 加形容词后缀 -ous 构成，意为「充满爱意的」。

latinIntro.en: The -ous suffix turns Latin nouns into English adjectives of abundance.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -ous 把拉丁名词变成表示「充满」的英语形容词。

items.example: Amor is another name for Cupid

items.exampleCN: 旅途中的一段短暂恋情

definition_zh: 无固定形状的；不定形的；无明确结构的；难以归类的
definition_en: without a clear shape or definite structure; vague and formless
core_image: 一滴摊在桌上的水银：永远抓不出固定的轮廓
scene: 雾从山谷里漫上来，看不见任何边缘和轮廓。An amorphous gray cloud swallowed the whole valley.
sceneCN: 这里的 amorphous 是「无固定形状的」（第 1 个义项：没有清晰轮廓）；句意是一团不定形的灰色云雾吞没了整个山谷。

pos.zh: 无定形的；无固定形状的

derivatives.zh: 形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「无定形地」
形容词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「无定形性」

senses.title: Having no definite physical shape
senses.titleCN: 无固定外形的：轮廓不清
senses.definition: lacking a distinct form or sharp outline
senses.definitionCN: 没有明确形状或清晰轮廓的
senses.example: The glacier moved like an amorphous white river.
senses.exampleCN: 冰川像一条不定形的白色河流缓缓移动。
senses.why: The Greek prefix a- cancels morphe, shape: literally shapeless.
senses.whyCN: 希腊否定前缀 a- 取消 morphe「形状」，字面即「无形」。

senses.title: Lacking internal organization or structure
senses.titleCN: 内部无结构的：松散无组织
senses.definition: having no organized internal arrangement, as of groups or systems
senses.definitionCN: 内部没有组织安排的，如团体或体系
senses.example: The protest began as an amorphous crowd with no leaders.
senses.exampleCN: 抗议起初只是一群没有领袖的松散人群。
senses.why: A shapeless thing has no skeleton, so the word fits any group without structure.
senses.whyCN: 无形之物没有骨架，这个词便顺理成章地用于没有架构的群体。

senses.title: Vague and hard to classify
senses.titleCN: 难以归类的：概念含混
senses.definition: too vague or indistinct to be put into a clear category
senses.definitionCN: 因含混不清而难以归入明确类别的
senses.example: Critics called the band's style amorphous, part rock and part jazz.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家称这个乐队的风格难以归类，一半摇滚一半爵士。
senses.why: What has no edges cannot be sorted into boxes with edges.
senses.whyCN: 没有边界的东西自然装不进有边界的格子里。

senses.title: Of solids lacking crystal structure
senses.titleCN: 非晶的：物理学中的无晶体结构固体
senses.definition: describing solids whose atoms are not arranged in an orderly crystal lattice
senses.definitionCN: 形容原子不按有序晶格排列的固体
senses.example: Glass is an amorphous solid, unlike salt.
senses.exampleCN: 玻璃是非晶体固体，与盐不同。
senses.why: Science borrowed the shapeless image for atoms without a fixed pattern.
senses.whyCN: 科学借用「无形状」的意象，指原子没有固定排布图案的固体。

senses.title: Of ideas or plans without definition
senses.titleCN: 想法计划不成形的：模糊未定
senses.definition: not yet worked out or clearly defined, as of concepts or intentions
senses.definitionCN: 尚未成形或未明确界定的，如概念或意图
senses.example: Her ambitions were still amorphous at graduation.
senses.exampleCN: 毕业时她的抱负仍然模糊未定。
senses.why: A plan without definition is a plan without shape.
senses.whyCN: 没有清晰界定的计划，就是没有形状的计划。

intro.en: Amorphous is Greek in origin: a- (without) plus morphe (form), first used by scientists for crystals without shape.
intro.cn: amorphous 源自希腊语：a-（无）加 morphe（形状），最早由科学家用于描述无定形晶体。

items.en: Root *merb-, to squeeze or bind, source of morphe.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *merb-「挤压、束缚」，是 morphe 的来源。

items.en: morphe, form or shape; famous from the god Morpheus, shaper of dreams.
items.cn: 希腊语 morphe「形式、形状」，梦神 Morpheus（梦境塑形者）由此得名。

items.en: amorphos, shapeless, formed with the negative a-.
items.cn: 希腊语加否定前缀 a- 构成 amorphos「无定形的」。

items.en: Chemists introduced amorphous for solids without crystalline form.
items.cn: 十八世纪化学家引入 amorphous 指无晶体形状的固体。

items.en: English amorphous appears in scientific writing and soon spreads to general use.
items.cn: 十八世纪三十年代英语 amorphous 见于科学文献，随后扩展到一般用法。

items.en: Now describes shapeless things, loose groups, vague ideas, and noncrystalline solids.
items.cn: 如今形容无形之物、松散群体、模糊概念与非晶体固体。

note.en: Separate amorphous from shape words of its own root and from near rivals for vagueness.
note.cn: 把 amorphous 与同根的「形状」词分开，并与其他表示含混的近义词对比。

entries.definition: a complete change of form; shares morphe but means transformation, not shapelessness.
entries.definitionCN: 变态、变形；同根 morphe，但指「形变」而非「无形」。

entries.definition: the Greek god who shapes dreams; personified morphe.
entries.definitionCN: 希腊梦神，「梦境塑形者」，morphe 的人格化。

entries.definition: having human form; morphe again, opposite direction from amorphous.
entries.definitionCN: 拟人化的；同根 morphe，词义方向与 amorphous 相反。

entries.definition: plain English shapeless, without the scientific or abstract tinge.
entries.definitionCN: 无形状的；普通用词，不带科学或抽象色彩。

entries.definition: cloudlike and vague, especially of ideas.
entries.definitionCN: 星云般模糊的；尤指想法含混。

entries.definition: lacking shape, often implying clumsiness rather than vagueness.
entries.definitionCN: 没有形状的；常含笨拙意味而非概念含混。

normalIntro.en: Split amorphous into a- plus morphe to hold its meaning.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amorphous 拆成 a- 加 morphe，词义就握在手里。

normal.en: a- (no) + morph (shape): no shape at all.
normal.cn: a-（无）+ morph（形状）：完全没有形状。

normal.en: Opposite family: metamorphosis changes shape; amorphous has none.
normal.cn: 对比词族：metamorphosis 是「变形」，amorphous 是「无形」。

normal.en: Science anchor: glass is the classic amorphous solid.
normal.cn: 科学锚点：玻璃是典型的非晶（amorphous）固体。

normal.en: Picture Morph from The Matrix shifting without a fixed face — amorphous.
normal.cn: 想象《黑客帝国》里变脸的探员——没有固定外形，即 amorphous。

normal.en: Abstract use pattern: amorphous crowd, amorphous idea, amorphous boundary.
normal.cn: 抽象用法套路：amorphous crowd（松散人群）、amorphous idea（模糊想法）、amorphous boundary（模糊边界）。

abstract.en: Watch fog roll in and dissolve the rooftops into gray nothing.
abstract.cn: 看浓雾漫过，把屋顶溶成一片灰色虚无。

abstract.en: Try to grip a handful of water — it always escapes your shape.
abstract.cn: 伸手抓一把水——它永远挣脱你给的形状。

abstract.en: A committee with no agenda floats like a blob; amorphous organization.
abstract.cn: 没有议程的委员会像一团漂浮的黏糊物——涣散无组织。

examples.en: The ink spread into an amorphous stain on the paper.
examples.cn: 墨水在纸上洇成一团不定形的污渍。

examples.en: His proposal remained amorphous after two hours of discussion.
examples.cn: 讨论两小时后，他的提案依然不成形。

examples.en: Silica gel is an amorphous material used as a drying agent.
examples.cn: 硅胶是一种用作干燥剂的非晶材料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿猫疯死」——阿猫揉过的毛线疯成一堆，死活看不出是什么形状，无定形。

root: 希腊语 a-（无）+ morphe（形状）→ amorphos（无定形的）→ 十八世纪科学用语 amorphous（非晶的、无定形的）。同根词：metamorphosis（变形）、morph（变形）、anthropomorphic（拟人的）、Morpheus（梦神）。

sensesIntro.en: From literal shapelessness, amorphous extends to loose organizations, unclassifiable styles, noncrystalline solids, and undefined plans.
sensesIntro.cn: 从字面的「无形状」出发，amorphous 扩展到涣散组织、无法归类的风格、非晶固体与未定型的计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blob that refuses every outline
core.cn: 核心意象：拒绝一切轮廓的一团东西

branches.en: Physical things without outline
branches.cn: 没有轮廓的实体

branches.en: Groups without internal skeleton
branches.cn: 没有内部架构的群体

branches.en: Styles and ideas that escape categories
branches.cn: 逃出类别的风格与概念

branches.en: Atoms without an orderly pattern
branches.cn: 原子排布无序的固体

branches.en: Plans not yet given definite form
branches.cn: 尚未定型的计划与意图

intro.en: Amorphous combines the Greek negative a- with the form root morph plus the adjective suffix -ous.
intro.cn: amorphous 由希腊否定前缀 a-、「形状」词根 morph 与形容词后缀 -ous 组成。

latinIntro.en: The morph- family supplies English with its vocabulary of form and shape.
latinIntro.cn: morph- 词族为英语提供了关于「形」的整套词汇。

items.exampleCN: 梦神 Morpheus 塑造梦境

items.meaning: to change smoothly from one form to another
items.example: the image morphed into a wolf

items.meaning: a body type with soft round form

definition_zh: 恋情；（尤指秘密的）风流韵事
definition_en: a love affair, especially a secret or illicit one
core_image: 深夜递出的一封信：藏在披风下的恋情
scene: 宫廷里人人低声议论着王妃与乐师的传闻。The queen's secret amour was the talk of the entire court.
sceneCN: 这里的 amour 是「秘密恋情」（第 1 个义项：隐秘的恋爱关系）；句意是王后的秘密恋情成为整个宫廷的谈资。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「含情脉脉的；多情的」
amorous 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「多情；柔情」
同根词，义为「情人；尤指不正当的恋人」

senses.title: A secret or illicit love affair
senses.titleCN: 秘密恋情：隐秘或越界的恋爱关系
senses.definition: a romantic relationship kept hidden, often because it is improper
senses.definitionCN: 因不合礼俗而隐藏的恋爱关系
senses.example: The novel recounts a dangerous amour in wartime Paris.
senses.exampleCN: 小说讲述了战时巴黎一段危险的恋情。
senses.why: From Latin amor, love: when love must hide, English reaches for the French word.
senses.whyCN: 源自拉丁语 amor「爱」：当爱必须隐藏时，英语便借用法语词。

senses.title: A love affair in general, literary register
senses.titleCN: 恋情泛称：文学语域的爱恋
senses.definition: a romantic attachment, without necessarily any secrecy, in elevated style
senses.definitionCN: 书卷语域中的浪漫恋情，不必然隐秘
senses.example: His early amours filled three volumes of letters.
senses.exampleCN: 他早年的恋情感事写满了三卷书信。
senses.why: The word keeps its French elegance, so writers use it for romance as a subject.
senses.whyCN: 这个词保留了法语的雅致，作家便用它来谈论作为主题的爱情。

senses.title: Courtly love in chivalric tradition
senses.titleCN: 骑士之爱：典雅爱情传统
senses.definition: the idealized, ritualized love of medieval courtly literature
senses.definitionCN: 中世纪骑士文学中理想化、仪式化的爱情
senses.example: The knight pledged service to his lady in the fashion of courtly amour.
senses.exampleCN: 骑士以典雅爱情的方式向贵妇人宣誓效忠。
senses.why: Medieval romance codified love into duties; the borrowed word carries that ritual air.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪骑士文学把爱情规则化，这个借词因此带有仪式感。

senses.title: The beloved person
senses.titleCN: 恋人：被爱的人本身
senses.definition: a person with whom one has a love affair; a lover
senses.definitionCN: 恋爱关系的对象；爱人
senses.example: He wrote poem after poem to his amour.
senses.exampleCN: 他为恋人写了一首又一首诗。
senses.why: The feeling word slides onto the person who causes it.
senses.whyCN: 指情感的词会滑向引发情感的人。

intro.en: Amour is the French form of Latin amor, love, borrowed into English with a hint of secrecy.
intro.cn: amour 是拉丁语 amor（爱）的法语形式，借入英语后带上一丝隐秘色彩。

items.en: Root *am-, to love.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *am-「爱」。

items.en: amor, love; the root verb is amare.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amor「爱」，动词原形为 amare。

items.en: amour, both the feeling of love and a love affair.
items.cn: 古法语 amour，既指爱之情感，也指一段恋情。

items.en: English borrows amour, at first simply meaning love.
items.cn: 十三世纪中世纪英语借入 amour，最初只表示「爱」。

items.en: The sense narrows to love affairs, often scandalous ones.
items.cn: 十六、十七世纪词义收窄为恋情，且常带绯闻色彩。

items.en: Now a literary word for a romantic or secret affair.
items.cn: 如今是表示浪漫或隐秘恋情的文学用语。

note.en: Tell amour apart from its love-root relatives and from rival affair words.
note.cn: 把 amour 与「爱」词根的亲属词区分开，并与其他「风流韵事」用词对比。

entries.definition: adjective showing love; amour is the affair itself.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词「多情的」；amour 是恋情本身，同根易混。

entries.definition: the person in an illicit affair; amour is the relationship, paramour the lover.
entries.definitionCN: 不正当的恋人；amour 指关系，paramour 指人，同根注意分工。

entries.definition: one who loves an activity unpaid; same root am-, different branch.
entries.definitionCN: 业余爱好者；同属 am- 词根但语义分支不同，勿混。

entries.definition: a romantic involvement, often secret; the plain modern word.
entries.definitionCN: 婚外情、恋情；现代最常用的普通说法。

entries.definition: a secret romantic link, French loanword like amour.
entries.definitionCN: 私情；与 amour 同为法语借词。

entries.definition: a secret meeting between lovers.
entries.definitionCN: 幽会；强调情人秘密会面。

normalIntro.en: Hear the love inside amour directly.
normalIntro.cn: 直接听出 amour 里的「爱」。

normal.en: amour is literally French for love.
normal.cn: amour 就是法语「爱」这个词本身。

normal.en: Family: amorous (adj.), amour (affair), paramour (lover).
normal.cn: 词族：amorous（多情的）、amour（恋情）、paramour（情人）。

normal.en: Cinema cue: Amour is an Oscar-winning French film about love.
normal.cn: 电影提示：《爱》是获奥斯卡奖的法国爱情片，片名即 amour。

normal.en: Add par- for paramour: the lover through (par) an amour.
normal.cn: 加 par- 成 paramour：穿过这段恋情的恋人。

normal.en: Register note: amour is literary; affair is everyday.
normal.cn: 语域提示：amour 偏书面，affair 是日常词。

abstract.en: A folded letter passed under a ballroom door — amour in one image.
abstract.cn: 舞厅门缝下递进的折起的信——一个画面就是 amour。

abstract.en: Two masked eyes at a Paris balcony at midnight.
abstract.cn: 午夜巴黎阳台上一双蒙面的眼睛。

abstract.en: Say 'a-MOOR' and picture love anchored secretly in a hidden harbor.
abstract.cn: 读 a-MOOR 时联想「秘密泊进港湾的爱」。

examples.en: The diaries reveal the statesman's lifelong amours.
examples.cn: 日记披露了这位政治家一生中的多段恋情。

examples.en: Scandal erupted when the princess's amour reached the press.
examples.cn: 王妃的恋情见报后，丑闻轰然爆发。

examples.en: Medieval poets celebrated the ideal of courtly amour.
examples.cn: 中世纪诗人歌颂典雅爱情理想。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿姆」——恋人们互相喊对方「阿姆（ma 母音倒装）」，亲昵到只肯低声叫，像藏着一段秘密恋情。

root: 拉丁语 amare（爱）→ amor（爱情）→ 古法语 amour → 十三世纪借入英语。同根词：amorous（多情的）、paramour（情人）、amateur（爱好者）、enamor（使迷恋）。

sensesIntro.en: Amour runs from hidden affairs through literary romance and courtly ritual love to the beloved person.
sensesIntro.cn: amour 从隐秘恋情出发，经文学浪漫与骑士式爱情，延伸到恋人本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: love that must hide its face
core.cn: 核心意象：必须蒙住脸的爱

branches.en: The hidden, improper relationship
branches.cn: 隐秘越界的恋爱关系

branches.en: Literary love as a subject
branches.cn: 作为文学主题的爱情

branches.en: Ritualized medieval courtly love
branches.cn: 仪式化的中世纪典雅爱情

branches.en: The person loved
branches.cn: 被爱的人

branches.en: Romance as elegant literary matter
branches.cn: 作为雅致文学素材的爱情

intro.en: Amour is pure amor dressed in French spelling, joined in English to a family of love words.
intro.cn: amour 就是换了法语拼写的 amor，在英语中汇入「爱」词家族。

latinIntro.en: Latin amor generates English words from passion to hobbies.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 amor 派生出英语中从爱情到爱好的众多词汇。

items.example: amor vincit omnia, love conquers all
items.exampleCN: amor vincit omnia 即「爱战胜一切」

definition_zh: 安培（电流单位）；安（培）
definition_en: the SI unit of electric current, equal to one coulomb per second
core_image: 水管里的水流：电流表上显示每秒流过多少「电荷水」
scene: 电工合上电闸，仪表指针稳稳停在标记处。The circuit draws fifteen amperes at full power.
sceneCN: 这里的 ampere 是「安培」（第 1 个义项：电流的国际单位）；句意是电路满功率运行时的电流为十五安培。

derivatives.zh: ampere 加名词后缀 -age 构成，义为「安培数；电流量」
由 ampere 缩合 meter 构成，义为「安培计；电流表」

senses.title: The SI base unit of electric current
senses.titleCN: 电流的国际基本单位
senses.definition: the standard SI unit for measuring electric current, defined by a fixed value of elementary charge
senses.definitionCN: 测量电流的国际单位制基本单位，由基本电荷的固定值定义
senses.example: One ampere equals the flow of about 6.24 quintillion electrons per second.
senses.exampleCN: 一安培相当于每秒约 624 亿亿个电子的流动。
senses.why: Named for Andre-Marie Ampere, the unit keeps the founder's name in every measurement.
senses.whyCN: 以安培（Andre-Marie Ampere）命名，这个单位让奠基人的名字留在每一次测量中。

senses.title: A quantity of current in a circuit
senses.titleCN: 电路中的电流量
senses.definition: a specific measured amount of current flowing in a circuit
senses.definitionCN: 电路中流过的具体电流数值
senses.example: The heater needs ten amperes to run safely.
senses.exampleCN: 取暖器需要十安培电流才能安全运行。
senses.why: Unit names double as measured quantities, like meters of cloth.
senses.whyCN: 单位名可以兼作数量名，就像「几米布」一样说「几安培电流」。

senses.title: Current capacity rating of devices
senses.titleCN: 设备的额定电流
senses.definition: the maximum or rated current a device or fuse can handle
senses.definitionCN: 设备或保险丝能承受的最大或额定电流
senses.example: Check the ampere rating before replacing the fuse.
senses.exampleCN: 更换保险丝前先查看额定电流值。
senses.why: Engineers label limits in amperes, so the unit became the limit itself.
senses.whyCN: 工程师用安培标注限额，这个单位便转指限额本身。

senses.title: Compound units built on the ampere
senses.titleCN: 含安培的复合单位
senses.definition: units such as ampere-hour or ampere per meter that combine the ampere with others
senses.definitionCN: 安时、安培每米等由安培与其他单位组合而成的单位
senses.example: The battery stores eighty ampere-hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这块电池容量为八十安时。
senses.why: Once a base unit exists, combinations multiply naturally.
senses.whyCN: 基本单位一旦确立，各种组合单位便自然衍生。

intro.en: Ampere honors Andre-Marie Ampere, the French physicist who founded electrodynamics; the unit name was adopted internationally in 1881.
intro.cn: ampere 纪念法国物理学家安德烈-马里·安培（电动力学奠基人）；1881 年国际采用其名为电流单位。

items.en: amper, amperus, an old provincial term for a double amphora (jar), source of the surname Ampere.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amper/amperus，古时地方用语，指双耳大酒坛，是姓氏 Ampere 的来源。

items.en: Ampere, a family name of craftsmen, borne by the physicist's father.
items.cn: 法语姓氏 Ampere，本为匠人家族姓氏，物理学家承自其父。

items.en: Andre-Marie Ampere formulated the laws of electrodynamics.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代，安德烈-马里·安培创立电动力学定律。

items.en: The first International Electrical Congress named the current unit the ampere.
items.cn: 1881 年首届国际电学大会将电流单位定名为 ampere。

items.en: The ampere became an SI base unit, redefined in 2019 by fixing the elementary charge.
items.cn: 安培成为国际单位制基本单位；2019 年改为以基本电荷固定值定义。

items.en: Now universal in engineering, shortened informally to amp.
items.cn: 如今广泛用于工程领域，口语常缩略为 amp。

note.en: Keep ampere straight against the other electrical units and its own shortened forms.
note.cn: 把 ampere 与其他电学单位及其缩略形式区分清楚。

entries.definition: informal short form of ampere; also slang for an amplifier.
entries.definitionCN: ampere 的口语缩略；亦可指扩音器（amplifier）。

entries.definition: the strength of current measured in amperes.
entries.definitionCN: 安培数；以安培计的电流强度。

entries.definition: an instrument measuring amperes; contraction of ampeRE-meter.
entries.definitionCN: 电流表；由 ampere-meter 缩合而成，注意不是 am-meter。

entries.definition: the unit of electric potential, named for Volta.
entries.definitionCN: 伏特；电压单位，以伏打命名。

entries.definition: the unit of power, equal to volts times amperes.
entries.definitionCN: 瓦特；功率单位，等于伏特乘安培。

entries.definition: the unit of resistance, named for Ohm.
entries.definitionCN: 欧姆；电阻单位，以欧姆命名。

normalIntro.en: Remember ampere as the water-flow gauge of electricity.
normalIntro.cn: 把 ampere 记成电流的「水流量表」。

normal.en: Ampere = the man; ampere = the current unit; amp = shortcut.
normal.cn: Ampere 是人名；ampere 是电流单位；amp 是简称。

normal.en: Water picture: volts are pressure, amperes are flow, ohms narrow the pipe.
normal.cn: 水路比喻：伏特是水压，安培是流量，欧姆是水管粗细。

normal.en: Power formula: watts = volts x amperes.
normal.cn: 功率公式：瓦特 = 伏特 × 安培。

normal.en: ammeter hides ampere-meter inside it.
normal.cn: ammeter（电流表）里藏着 ampere-meter。

normal.en: Battery labels use ampere-hours: A x time = capacity.
normal.cn: 电池标注用安时：电流 × 时间 = 容量。

abstract.en: Picture electrons rushing through a wire like cars past a toll gate counter.
abstract.cn: 想象电子像过收费站的汽车，一秒内冲过计数器。

abstract.en: Ampere sounds like 'amp up' — turning the current up.
abstract.cn: ampere 开头像「amp up」——把电流调大。

abstract.en: A fuse marked 15A says: no more than fifteen amperes or I blow.
abstract.cn: 标着 15A 的保险丝说：超过十五安培我就烧断。

examples.en: The motor draws thirty amperes at startup.
examples.cn: 电机启动时电流达三十安培。

examples.en: Never replace a twenty ampere fuse with a thirty ampere one.
examples.cn: 切勿用三十安培的保险丝替换二十安培的。

examples.en: He connected the ammeter to read the amperes flowing.
examples.cn: 他接上电流表读取流过的安培数。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安培」本就是中文标准译名——「安」稳地「培」送电流，一安培就是一份安安稳稳的电流。

root: ampere 源自法国物理学家 Andre-Marie Ampere 的姓氏；姓氏更早可溯源至拉丁语 amper（双耳酒坛）。1881 年国际电学大会以其名定为电流单位，1948 年纳入国际单位制基本单位。

sensesIntro.en: From the base unit itself, ampere extends to measured currents, device ratings, and compound units like the ampere-hour.
sensesIntro.cn: 从基本单位出发，ampere 扩展到实测电流、设备额定值以及安时等复合单位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gauge counting electrons per second
core.cn: 核心意象：每秒清点电子的仪表

branches.en: The defined base unit of the SI system
branches.cn: 国际单位制定义的电流基本单位

branches.en: Actual current measured in a circuit
branches.cn: 电路中实际测得的电流

branches.en: Limits printed on fuses and devices
branches.cn: 标注在保险丝与设备上的限额

branches.en: Compound units combining amperes with time or distance
branches.cn: 安培与时间距离组合的复合单位

branches.en: The living flow of charge in wires
branches.cn: 导线中真实流动的电荷

intro.en: Ampere is an eponym: a scientist's surname turned into a unit, then into compounds.
intro.cn: ampere 是人名转化词：科学家姓氏变单位，再衍生复合词。

latinIntro.en: The surname itself descends from a Latin jar-name.
latinIntro.cn: 这个姓氏本身可追溯到拉丁语的酒坛之名。

items.meaningCN: 库仑；电荷单位，一安培秒

items.example: a short circuit tripped the breaker

items.meaning: a safety wire that melts at excess current
items.meaningCN: 保险丝；超流熔断的保险装置

latinEntries.meaningCN: 双耳酒坛；姓氏 Ampere 的远源

definition_zh: 水陆两栖的；水陆两用的；兼具两种活动领域能力的
definition_en: able to live or operate both in water and on land
core_image: 脚踏两只世界的青蛙：水里能游，岸上能跳
scene: 登陆艇冲上沙滩，舱门放下，士兵与战车鱼贯而出。The army launched an amphibious assault at dawn.
sceneCN: 这里的 amphibious 是「水陆两用的」（第 3 个义项：军事上跨越水陆两域作战）；句意是军队在黎明发起两栖登陆进攻。

pos.zh: 水陆两用的；两栖作战的

derivatives.zh: 同根名词，义为「两栖动物；两栖飞机」
形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「水陆两栖地」
同前缀词（amphi- 表「两」），义为「歧义句；结构含混的表述」

senses.title: Able to live both in water and on land
senses.titleCN: 水陆两栖的：动物双栖能力
senses.definition: of animals, especially frogs and salamanders, capable of living in water and on land
senses.definitionCN: 指蛙、蝾螈等动物既能水中生活也能陆地生活
senses.example: Frogs are the most familiar amphibious creatures.
senses.exampleCN: 青蛙是我们最熟悉的两栖动物。
senses.why: The Greek amphi means both ways and bios means life: a double life.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 amphi 意为「双向」，bios 意为「生命」：即过双重生活。

senses.title: Of plants growing in both water and soil
senses.titleCN: 水陆两生的：植物双环境生长
senses.definition: of plants able to grow in water or in wet soil
senses.definitionCN: 能在水中或湿地土壤中生长的植物属性
senses.example: Rice is essentially an amphibious plant.
senses.exampleCN: 水稻本质上是一种水陆两生植物。
senses.why: The double-life idea transfers from animals to anything that straddles both worlds.
senses.whyCN: 「双重生活」的观念从动物转移到任何横跨两个世界的事物。

senses.title: Of military operations crossing sea and land
senses.titleCN: 两栖作战的：跨越海陆的军事行动
senses.definition: of military forces or operations launched from sea onto land
senses.definitionCN: 指由海向陆发起的军事力量或行动
senses.example: The allies trained for months before the amphibious landing.
senses.exampleCN: 盟军为两栖登陆训练了数月。
senses.why: Soldiers, like frogs, must cross the waterline; war borrowed the zoology term.
senses.whyCN: 士兵如青蛙必须跨越水线，军事领域借用了动物学术语。

senses.title: Of vehicles and aircraft operating on water and land
senses.titleCN: 水陆两用的：交通工具跨域运行
senses.definition: of vehicles or aircraft designed to operate on both water and land
senses.definitionCN: 指设计为可在水面与陆地运行的载具
senses.example: The amphibious truck drove straight off the beach into the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆水陆两用卡车从沙滩径直驶入海湾。
senses.why: Engineering gave machines the frog's trick, and kept the frog's word.
senses.whyCN: 工程学赋予机器青蛙的本领，也沿用了青蛙的名称。

senses.title: Operating in two distinct realms or modes
senses.titleCN: 横跨两个领域的：比喻用法
senses.definition: functioning in two different environments or modes, used figuratively
senses.definitionCN: 比喻在两种不同环境或模式下运作
senses.example: She lived an amphibious life between the studio and the trading floor.
senses.exampleCN: 她在画室与交易所之间过着双栖生活。
senses.why: Any double life, literal or not, invites the amphibian image.
senses.whyCN: 任何「双重生活」，无论字面与否，都会引来两栖意象。

intro.en: Amphibious comes from Greek amphibios, living a double life, from amphi (both) plus bios (life).
intro.cn: amphibious 源自希腊语 amphibios「过双重生活的」，由 amphi（双向）加 bios（生命）构成。

items.en: Root *gweih-, to live, source of bios and biology.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *gweih-「生活」，是 bios 与 biology 的来源。

items.en: amphi, on both sides; bios, life; amphibios, leading a double life.
items.cn: 希腊语 amphi「两边」；bios「生命」；amphibios「双重生活」。

items.en: amphibius borrowed from Greek in natural history writing.
items.cn: 拉丁语在博物学著作中借入 amphibius。

items.en: English amphibious first described creatures living on land and in water.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 amphibious 先用于描述水陆两栖生物。

items.en: The word extended to plants, then to machines and military operations.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪该词扩展到植物，再到机械与军事行动。

items.en: Now standard in zoology, engineering, and military terminology.
items.cn: 如今是动物学、工程学与军事术语的标准用词。

note.en: Distinguish amphibious from its amphi- cousins and from words of double nature.
note.cn: 区分 amphibious 与其他 amphi- 前缀词，以及表示双重属性的词。

entries.definition: noun for a two-living creature or craft; amphibious is the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 名词「两栖动物/两栖飞机」；amphibious 是其形容词。

entries.definition: a round theater with seats on all sides; amphi- here means around, not double life.
entries.definitionCN: 环形剧场；amphi- 此处指「四周环绕」，与「双重生活」无关。

entries.definition: open to two readings; from ambigere, not from bios.
entries.definitionCN: 模棱两可的；源自拉丁语 ambigere，词根不同，勿与 amphibious 混。

entries.definition: living or growing in water only; half of the amphibious range.
entries.definitionCN: 水生的；只覆盖两栖范围的一半。

entries.definition: living on land only; the other half.
entries.definitionCN: 陆生的；两栖范围的另一半。

entries.definition: a mix of two kinds; broader double-nature idea.
entries.definitionCN: 混合的；泛指两种属性的结合。

normalIntro.en: Fix amphibious by hearing both lives inside it.
normalIntro.cn: 听出 amphibious 里的「双重生命」就能记牢。

normal.en: amphi (both) + bios (life) + -ous: living both ways.
normal.cn: amphi（双向）+ bios（生命）+ -ous：过双重生活。

normal.en: amphi family: amphibious (two lives), amphitheater (seats all around).
normal.cn: amphi 词族：amphibious（两栖）、amphitheater（环形剧场）。

normal.en: Anchor image: a frog, half swimmer, half jumper.
normal.cn: 锚定画面：青蛙，一半是泳者，一半是跳将。

normal.en: Military set phrase: amphibious landing ship.
normal.cn: 军事固定短语：amphibious landing ship（两栖登陆舰）。

normal.en: The noun amphibian doubles as both animal and aircraft.
normal.cn: 名词 amphibian 既指两栖动物也指两栖飞机。

abstract.en: See a truck splash into a river and keep driving on the riverbed.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆卡车冲进河里，继续在河床上行驶。

abstract.en: A seal hauled out on the rocks, at home in both worlds.
abstract.cn: 海豹爬上礁石，在两个世界里都自在。

abstract.en: Bilingual professional by day, fisherman at dawn — amphibious schedule.
abstract.cn: 白天双语白领、清晨垂钓者——「两栖」日程。

examples.en: Salamanders are shy amphibious animals of the forest streams.
examples.cn: 蝾螈是林间溪流中羞怯的两栖动物。

examples.en: The navy tested a new amphibious transport dock.
examples.cn: 海军测试了一艘新型两栖船坞运输舰。

examples.en: Rescue teams used amphibious vehicles in the flooded town.
examples.cn: 救援队在被淹的城镇使用水陆两用车。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安母比鹅死」——青蛙妈妈跟鹅比游泳，鹅输了（比鹅死），因为青蛙水陆两栖，水里赢了鹅。

root: 希腊语 amphi（两边、双向）+ bios（生命，源自印欧词根 *gweih-「生活」）→ amphibios（双重生活）→ 拉丁语 amphibius → 英语 amphibious（水陆两栖的）。同前缀词：amphitheater（环形剧场）、amphora（双耳瓶）。

sensesIntro.en: From the double life of frogs, amphibious spreads to plants, machines, armies, and anyone living in two worlds.
sensesIntro.cn: 从青蛙的双重生活出发，amphibious 扩展到植物、机械、军队乃至活在两个世界的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one creature owning two worlds
core.cn: 核心意象：一只生灵同时拥有两个世界

branches.en: Animals at home in water and on land
branches.cn: 水陆两栖的动物

branches.en: Plants rooted in both worlds
branches.cn: 水陆两生的植物

branches.en: Armies stepping from ship to shore
branches.cn: 由舰上岸的两栖作战

branches.en: Vehicles engineered for both terrains
branches.cn: 双地形设计的载具

branches.en: People or habits spanning two realms
branches.cn: 横跨两个领域的比喻用法

intro.en: Amphibious shows the Greek prefix amphi- doing its job of spanning two sides.
intro.cn: amphibious 展示了希腊前缀 amphi-「横跨两边」的构词功能。

latinIntro.en: The amphi- family marks symmetry and doubleness across English.
latinIntro.cn: amphi- 词族在英语中标记对称与双重。

items.example: amphitheater has seats on all sides
biology is the study of life
amphibious means having a double life
items.exampleCN: amphibious 意为「过双重生活的」

items.meaning: an oval theater open all around
able to use both hands equally
items.meaningCN: 双手都灵巧的；平行前缀对照
模棱两可的；易混词对照

definition_zh: 圆形剧场；环形竞技场；（阶梯式）露天看台
definition_en: an oval or round building with tiers of seats rising around a central arena
core_image: 古罗马斗兽场：层层石阶围着中央的沙地
scene: 游客们站在罗马古城的遗迹中央抬头仰望四周的石阶。Thousands once filled the amphitheater to watch the gladiators.
sceneCN: 这里的 amphitheater 是「环形竞技场」（第 1 个义项：环绕中央场地的阶梯观众建筑）；句意是曾经有数千人坐满这座竞技场观看角斗士表演。

pos.zh: 阶梯教室；倾斜看台式场所

derivatives.zh: 加形容词后缀 -ric 构成，义为「环形剧场式的；阶梯排列的」
形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「呈阶梯状地」

senses.title: A classical oval arena ringed by seats
senses.titleCN: 古典环形竞技场：古罗马式建筑
senses.definition: an ancient oval or circular structure with rising tiers of seats around an arena
senses.definitionCN: 古代环形或椭圆形建筑，中央场地四周是层层升高的座位
senses.example: The Colosseum is the greatest amphitheater of antiquity.
senses.exampleCN: 罗马斗兽场是古代最宏伟的竞技场。
senses.why: The Greek amphi means around: seats surround the stage on every side, doubling a normal theater.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 amphi 意为「四周」：座位环绕舞台，等于把普通剧场翻了一倍。

senses.title: A modern open-air venue
senses.titleCN: 现代露天剧场
senses.definition: a contemporary outdoor venue with tiered seating facing a stage
senses.definitionCN: 现代的露天演出场所，阶梯座位面向舞台
senses.example: The summer concerts moved to the lakeside amphitheater.
senses.exampleCN: 夏季音乐会移到了湖边露天剧场。
senses.why: Modern builders reused the classical shape for summer shows under the sky.
senses.whyCN: 现代建造者把古典形制改造成夏日露天的演出场地。

senses.title: A steeply tiered lecture hall
senses.titleCN: 阶梯教室：层层升高的报告厅
senses.definition: an indoor hall with ascending rows of seats, as in universities or hospitals
senses.definitionCN: 座位逐排升高的室内厅堂，常见于大学或医院
senses.example: First-year lectures are held in the science amphitheater.
senses.exampleCN: 一年级的课在理科阶梯教室上。
senses.why: The rising-seat design is the same; only the show changes, from gladiators to lectures.
senses.whyCN: 座位层层升高的设计没变，只是上演的从角斗换成了讲课。

senses.title: A natural terrain shaped like one
senses.titleCN: 天然环形地貌
senses.definition: a natural hollow or valley surrounded by rising slopes, resembling the building
senses.definitionCN: 四周被高坡环抱的天然洼地或山谷
senses.example: The glacier carved a great amphitheater in the mountainside.
senses.exampleCN: 冰川在山坡上刻出一个巨大的环形谷地。
senses.why: Geology borrowed the architectural shape for landforms that mimic it.
senses.whyCN: 地质学借用建筑形制，为形似的天然地貌命名。

intro.en: Amphitheater is Greek amphi (around) plus theatron (place for viewing), naming a theater viewed from all sides.
intro.cn: amphitheater 由希腊语 amphi（四周）加 theatron（观演之地）构成，指可从各面观看的剧场。

items.en: Root *ambhi-, around, source of both amphi- and ambi-.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *ambhi-「周围」，是 amphi- 与 ambi- 的共同来源。

items.en: amphi, on both sides; theatron, watching place, from theasthai, to behold.
items.cn: 希腊语 amphi「两边」；theatron「观看之处」，动词 theasthai「观看」。

items.en: amphitheatrum, the Roman stone arenas such as the Colosseum.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amphitheatrum，指罗马石造竞技场如斗兽场。

items.en: English amphitheater enters through Latin learned borrowing.
items.cn: 英语经拉丁书面语借入 amphitheater。

items.en: The word widened to lecture halls and natural landforms.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪词义扩展到阶梯教室与天然地貌。

items.en: Now covers ancient arenas, open-air venues, and tiered halls.
items.cn: 如今涵盖古代竞技场、露天剧场与阶梯厅堂。

note.en: Keep amphitheater distinct from the plain theater and its amphi- cousins.
note.cn: 把 amphitheater 与普通 theater 以及 amphi- 同前缀词区分开。

entries.definition: a building for plays, usually with seats on one side only.
entries.definitionCN: 剧场；座位通常只在一面，与 amphitheater 的环形相对。

entries.definition: a creature of two lives; shares amphi- but nothing else.
entries.definitionCN: 两栖动物；同属 amphi- 前缀但语义无关。

entries.definition: a two-handled Greek jar; amphi- meaning double handles.
entries.definitionCN: 双耳瓶；amphi- 此处指「两只」耳柄。

entries.definition: the central performance space, or any modern venue of contest.
entries.definitionCN: 竞技场地；也泛指现代比赛或表演场馆。

entries.definition: a very large amphitheater, originally the name of Rome's own.
entries.definitionCN: 大型竞技场；原为罗马斗兽场专名。

entries.definition: a sports venue with a running track, seats on two long sides.
entries.definitionCN: 体育场；带跑道、两侧设座的运动场馆。

normalIntro.en: Break amphitheater into around plus viewing place.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amphitheater 拆成「四周」加「观看之地」。

normal.en: amphi (around) + theater: a theater all around you.
normal.cn: amphi（四周）+ theater（剧场）：把你围在中间的剧场。

normal.en: The Colosseum is the picture to anchor: stone rings around sand.
normal.cn: 锚定画面：罗马斗兽场——石环围着中央沙地。

normal.en: amphi- cousins: amphora (two handles), amphibious (two lives).
normal.cn: amphi- 亲属：amphora（双耳瓶）、amphibious（两栖）。

normal.en: campus use: the science amphitheater = stepped lecture hall.
normal.cn: 校园用法：science amphitheater 即阶梯教室。

normal.en: British spelling swaps -er for -re: amphitheatre.
normal.cn: 英式拼写把 -er 换成 -re：amphitheatre。

abstract.en: Stand at the center and turn in a circle: every face you see has a seat.
abstract.cn: 站在中央转一圈：你看到的每一张脸都有座位。

abstract.en: Hear 'AM-FEE' like two fees paid by spectators on both sides.
abstract.cn: 读 AM-FEE 时联想两侧观众各付一份「门票费」。

abstract.en: Picture a valley whose slopes look like rows of empty benches.
abstract.cn: 想象山谷的坡面像一排排空长凳——天然看台。

examples.en: The ruined amphitheater still hosts open-air plays each summer.
examples.cn: 这座废墟竞技场每年夏天仍上演露天戏剧。

examples.en: Students crowded the medical amphitheater to watch the surgery demonstration.
examples.cn: 学生们挤满医学院阶梯教室观看手术演示。

examples.en: Our seats in the amphitheater rose in perfect tiers above the stage.
examples.cn: 我们的座位在露天剧场中呈完美的阶梯层层升高。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安母非替尔」——安妈妈发现这里「并非『替』代普通剧场」的普通建筑，而是四面围着的环形剧场。

root: 希腊语 amphi（四周、两边）+ theatron（观演场所，源自 theasthai「观看」）→ 拉丁语 amphitheatrum → 英语 amphitheater。同根词：theater（剧场）、theory（理论，同「观看」词根）、amphora（双耳瓶）。

sensesIntro.en: From the stone arenas of Rome, amphitheater widened to open-air venues, tiered lecture halls, and landforms that copy the shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 从罗马石造竞技场出发，amphitheater 扩展到露天剧场、阶梯教室以及形似的天然地貌。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: seats rising in a ring around the action
core.cn: 核心意象：座位层层升起，环形围住中央舞台

branches.en: The classical stone building of ancient shows
branches.cn: 古代演出用的石造环形建筑

branches.en: Modern outdoor stages with tiered seats
branches.cn: 带阶梯座位的现代露天舞台

branches.en: Indoor halls for lectures and demonstrations
branches.cn: 用于讲课演示的阶梯厅堂

branches.en: Valleys and craters shaped like the building
branches.cn: 形似该建筑的天然洼地

branches.en: Summer shows under the open sky
branches.cn: 露天星空下的夏季演出

intro.en: Amphitheater keeps its Greek parts intact: around plus a place of viewing.
intro.cn: amphitheater 完整保留了希腊语构件：「四周」加「观看之地」。

latinIntro.en: The thea- root of seeing also feeds theory and theater.
latinIntro.cn: 表示「观看」的 thea- 词根也孕育了 theory 与 theater。

items.example: a theater is a viewing place

latinEntries.meaning: an oval arena with rising seats
latinEntries.meaningCN: 座位层层升高的椭圆形竞技场

definition_zh: 充足地；绰绰有余地；广泛地；充分地
definition_en: in a way that is more than enough; fully and generously
core_image: 倒得冒尖的酒杯：给的比要的多
scene: 奖学金不仅覆盖了学费，连生活费都绰绰有余。The scholarship covered her expenses amply.
sceneCN: 这里的 amply 是「绰绰有余地」（第 1 个义项：数量超过需要）；句意是这笔奖学金充裕地覆盖了她的全部开销。

derivatives.zh: 基础形容词，义为「充足的；宽敞的；丰满的」
同根动词，义为「放大；增强；扩充」
同根名词，义为「振幅；广阔；充足」
amplify 加施动者后缀 -er 构成，义为「放大器」

senses.title: More than sufficiently in quantity
senses.titleCN: 数量上绰绰有余地
senses.definition: to a degree that exceeds what is needed in amount or size
senses.definitionCN: 在数量或规模上超过所需的程度
senses.example: The garden amply feeds a family of six.
senses.exampleCN: 这座菜园足可供养六口之家。
senses.why: From Latin amplus, large: whatever is made large overflows the measure of need.
senses.whyCN: 源自拉丁语 amplus「大」：被放大之物自然溢出需求的量器。

senses.title: Fully, so as to leave no doubt
senses.titleCN: 充分地：足以消除疑问
senses.definition: completely or thoroughly, especially of proof or demonstration
senses.definitionCN: 彻底地、透彻地，尤指论证或证明
senses.example: The data amply support the hypothesis.
senses.exampleCN: 这些数据充分支持这一假设。
senses.why: Generosity of evidence parallels generosity of quantity: both overfill.
senses.whyCN: 证据的「丰裕」与数量的「丰裕」平行：都是满得溢出来。

senses.title: Generously, with more than fair treatment
senses.titleCN: 慷慨地：超出应得的善待
senses.definition: in a way that gives more than is fair or expected, as of rewards or praise
senses.definitionCN: 给予超出应得或预期的方式，如回报或赞扬
senses.example: His loyalty was amply repaid by the company.
senses.exampleCN: 公司给他的忠诚以丰厚的回报。
senses.why: A large measure given to a person feels like generosity.
senses.whyCN: 给人的量器一旦放大，感受上就是慷慨。

senses.title: Widely, with breadth of scope
senses.titleCN: 广泛地：范围宽阔
senses.definition: with broad extent or coverage, as of powers or descriptions
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖面广、范围宽，如权力或描述
senses.example: The constitution amply defines the president's powers.
senses.exampleCN: 宪法对总统权力的规定十分宽泛。
senses.why: Amplus also meant broad; wide scope is another kind of large.
senses.whyCN: amplus 也表示「宽阔」，范围之广正是另一种「大」。

intro.en: Amply is the adverb of ample, from Latin amplus, large or spacious, reaching English through Old French.
intro.cn: amply 是 ample 的副词，源自拉丁语 amplus「大的、宽敞的」，经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Root *am-, a container or bucket, source of amplus.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *am-「容器、桶」，是 amplus 的来源。

items.en: amplus, large, spacious, honorable.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amplus「大的、宽敞的、尊贵的」。

items.en: ample, large or wide.
items.cn: 古法语 ample「大的、宽的」。

items.en: English ample appears meaning large or generous.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语 ample 出现，意为大的、慷慨的。

items.en: amply formed with the adverbial suffix -ly.
items.cn: 十六世纪加副词后缀 -ly 构成 amply。

items.en: Now signals sufficiency with a margin: more than enough.
items.cn: 如今表示有余量的充足：比需要的还多。

note.en: Set amply against its own root family and rival adverbs of sufficiency.
note.cn: 把 amply 与同根词以及表示充足的其他副词对比。

entries.definition: the base adjective: enough and more; amply is its adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 基础形容词「充足的」；amply 是其副词形式。

entries.definition: to make larger or louder; the action version of the root.
entries.definitionCN: 放大；增强；同根的「动作版」。

entries.definition: to stamp heavily; rhymes with ample but unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 踩踏；与 ample 押韵但词源无关。

entries.definition: to the needed degree, with no implication of surplus.
entries.definitionCN: 足够地；只到所需程度，无「有余」之意。

entries.definition: with kindness in giving; stresses the giver's attitude.
entries.definitionCN: 慷慨地；强调给予者的态度。

entries.definition: completely, without necessarily exceeding need.
entries.definitionCN: 完全地；不必然超出所需。

normalIntro.en: Keep amply tied to its overflowing root.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amply 和「满溢」的词根绑在一起。

normal.en: ample + -ly: in ample fashion, with room to spare.
normal.cn: ample（充足的）+ -ly（副词后缀）：以充足的方式，绰绰有余。

normal.en: Latin amplus = large; everything in the family means big.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 amplus 即「大」；同族词都含「大」义。

normal.en: Family: ample, amply, amplify, amplitude, amplifier.
normal.cn: 词族：ample、amply、amplify（放大）、amplitude（振幅）、amplifier（放大器）。

normal.en: Contrast: sufficiently = just enough; amply = more than enough.
normal.cn: 对比：sufficiently 是刚好够，amply 是还有富余。

normal.en: Common pairs: amply rewarded, amply demonstrated, amply supplied.
normal.cn: 常见搭配：amply rewarded（厚报）、amply demonstrated（充分证明）、amply supplied（供应充足）。

abstract.en: A teapot pouring until the cup overflows into the saucer.
abstract.cn: 茶壶一直倒，直到茶水溢出杯外流进茶托。

abstract.en: An essay with twenty footnotes for one claim — amply documented.
abstract.cn: 一个论点配二十条脚注——文献「翔实充分」。

abstract.en: A coat one size too big: amply sized, room everywhere.
abstract.cn: 大一号的外套：尺寸「宽裕」，处处有余量。

examples.en: Years of patience were amply rewarded at harvest.
examples.cn: 多年的耐心在丰收时得到了丰厚回报。

examples.en: The witness amply described every detail of the scene.
examples.cn: 证人把现场细节描述得十分详尽。

examples.en: Supplies were amply stocked before the winter storm.
examples.cn: 冬季风暴来临前，物资储备已经十分充足。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安普利」——安安稳稳又普遍又有利，好处多得用不完，即「充足有余地」。

root: 拉丁语 amplus（大的、宽敞的，一般认为源自印欧词根 *am-「容器」）→ 古法语 ample → 英语 ample → 加 -ly 构成 amply。同根词：amplify（放大）、amplitude（振幅）、amplifier（放大器）、amplification（扩充）。

sensesIntro.en: From overflowing quantity, amply runs to thorough proof, generous reward, and wide scope.
sensesIntro.cn: 从满溢的数量出发，amply 延伸到透彻的证明、慷慨的回报与宽阔的范围。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the cup filled past its brim
core.cn: 核心意象：满过杯沿的酒杯

branches.en: Quantities exceeding need
branches.cn: 超出所需的数量

branches.en: Evidence and arguments that overfill doubt
branches.cn: 多得令疑问无处容身的证据

branches.en: Rewards exceeding what is owed
branches.cn: 超出应得的回报

branches.en: Powers and texts of wide coverage
branches.cn: 覆盖面宽泛的权力与文本

branches.en: Giving beyond what is owed
branches.cn: 给予超出应得的部分

intro.en: Amply is simply ample plus the adverb maker -ly.
intro.cn: amply 就是 ample 加副词后缀 -ly。

latinIntro.en: The ampl- root generates English words about largeness and enlargement.
latinIntro.cn: ampl- 词根衍生出英语中关于「大与放大」的词汇。

items.meaning: the act of enlarging or elaborating
